description: Logits from N(0, 3²), [16, 10], no label smoothing.
notes: loss is the batch mean (reduction "mean"), shape [1]; grad_prediction its gradient with respect to the prediction, upstream gradient 1. Both computed in f64 on the f32 inputs and rounded once to f32 (testing-strategy.md §3.3, §3.7); PyTorch's own f32 result meets the tolerance, and training.md §3.3's formulas in f64 agree with PyTorch's f64 result. The config is the loss object without prediction and target; left-out fields take training.md §2.6's defaults. The target holds class indices, stored as I64 (testing-strategy.md §3.7); the Rust test also runs the case with them converted to i32, which training.md §3.3 reads as i64.
